prompt: Create an original 60 second melodic breakbeat electronica instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: breakbeat drums, rounded bass, shimmering synth. Style: syncopated chopped drum rhythm under an evolving melody. Tempo approximately 124 BPM; D major. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: An electronic track featuring a steady beat, atmospheric synth pads, and a melancholic lead melody. The music has a chill, somewhat spacey vibe with a consistent rhythm.
description.zh: 一首电子音乐，具有稳定的节拍、氛围感合成器音垫和忧郁的主旋律。音乐营造出一种轻松、略带太空感的氛围，节奏连贯。
